name: print-social-red-photo-frame-festival-poster
title: Festival poster with a white frame around a red-toned performer
whatItIs: A portrait poster with a red-tinted photo of a smiling man in sunglasses. A thick white rectangle frames him, with the event logo and date across the top and 'main stage' on the bottom edge. Sponsor logos sit at the base.
whatItMeans: Bold and simple; the frame turns the performer into a picture or ticket.
techniques: Frame a subject with a thick white border, letting their hands break the frame.
Tint the photo a single colour and keep the frame neutral.
Place event metadata inside the frame edges.
Let a small logo cluster close the poster.

vocabulary.definition: A subject extending beyond a border.
A plain frame around a picture.
A poster or card featuring one performer.
A single colour applied to a photo.
